EC1: Previously enrolled in this study (i.e. patient now at repeat encounter)
EC2: Concomitant surgical procedure [AND] other than CABG
EC3: Anticoagulant treatment after the operation (e.g. warfarin [OR], direct thrombin inhibitors [OR] (dabigatran), FXa inhibitors (rivaroxaban [OR], apixaban [OR], heparin [OR], low-molecular weight heparin [OR], fondaparinux)
EC4: Discharge [AND] from the operating hospital to an ICU at another hospital
EC6: Known intolerance [OR] or contraindication to ticagrelor [OR] or ASA
EC7: Any disorder that may interfere with drug absorption
EC8: Any condition [AND] [NOT] other than coronary artery disease with a life expectancy <12 months
EC9: Known chronic liver disease [OR], renal disease [OR] requiring dialysis or bleeding disorder
EC10: Atrioventricular block [OR] II and III in patients [NOT] without pacemaker
EC11: Any other indication [AND] for dual antiplatelet therapy, i.e. recent stent implantation
EC12: Debilitating [AND] stroke within 90 days before inclusion
EC14: Treatment with immunosuppressants (e.g. cyclosporine [OR] and tacrolimus)
EC15: Treatment with strong CYP3A4-inhibitors (e.g. ketoconazole [OR], clarithromycin [OR], nefazodone [OR], ritonavir [OR] or atazanavir)
EC16: Any condition that in the opinion of the investigator may interfere with adherence to trial protocol
